content: When the roots of a tree begin to decay, it spreads death to the highest branches.
author: African Proverbs
explanation: You can polish the leaves and paint the bark of a dying tree, but if rot has infected the hidden taproot beneath the soil, the entire canopy will crash down in the next wind. Institutional, personal, or societal ruin always begins in private ethical rot.
practicalInsight: Guard your private integrity with absolute ferocity. What you do in the dark when no one is watching is your true root system.
reflectionPrompt: Is there a quiet compromise or ethical decay in your private life that threatens to bring down your public branches?
